results.title: Klaviyo's Q1 2026: The Quarter It Started Making Money | Eightx
results.summary: For the quarter ended March 31, 2026, Klaviyo reported revenue of $358.0 million, up 28% from $279.8 million a year earlier. It posted its first positive GAAP operating income of $1.7 million and GAAP net income of $9.0 million, or $0.03 per diluted share, versus a $14.1 million net loss in Q1 2025. The results beat analyst revenue and EPS estimates.
